currentFindings.title: Urban Mobility Explained (UMX) Open Call · second cut-off
currentFindings.funding: Indicative call allocation EUR 2-4 million; maximum EIT funding EUR 700,000 per proposal
currentFindings.eligibilityEvidence: EIT Urban Mobility explicitly lists cities among eligible legal entities. Mono-participant and multi-participant proposals are both allowed. Fit remains conditional on the municipality being able to develop/deliver scalable professional urban-mobility training or support services.

currentFindings.title: HORIZON-CL3-2026-01-SSRI-02 · Demand-led innovation in security
currentFindings.funding: Horizon Europe Pre-Commercial Procurement; indicative topic budget EUR 5.83 million
currentFindings.eligibilityEvidence: The consortium must include at least 3 practitioners and 3 procurers from at least 3 countries; at least 2 procurers must be independent public procurers. A municipality can participate where it has the relevant civil-security procurement/practitioner role.

currentFindings.title: HORIZON-CL3-2026-01-SSRI-03 · Public procurement of innovation for security
currentFindings.funding: Horizon Europe Public Procurement of Innovative Solutions; indicative topic budget EUR 2 million
currentFindings.eligibilityEvidence: The topic requires at least 3 practitioners and 3 public procurers from at least 3 countries, with at least 2 independent public procurers. Municipal participation is conditional on a relevant security procurement function.

scopeAndLifecycleControls.title: 6th Call for Cross-Border Renewable Energy projects to obtain CB RES status
scopeAndLifecycleControls.note: Current and absent from the reference snapshot, but not a generic municipal grant. The project must be based on a Renewable Energy Directive cooperation mechanism and supported by participating Member States. Do not auto-promote to the seven municipalities.

The Commission directory is the correct oracle for Mission Ocean Associated Regions. The listed Associated Regions calls checked in this sweep are closed; SUNDANSE Open Call 2 remains separately current and already captured by the audit corpus.
The LDT4SSC project now marks all three open calls closed. Do not count the family as a current actionable gap on 8 September 2026.

The official Commission application page now states an extended deadline of 16 October 2026 at 12:00 CEST. Earlier audit material using 30 September should be treated as stale deadline metadata, not a new opportunity gap.

A real city-facing participation opportunity, but not funding, technical assistance, an award or a structured capacity-building programme. Keep as a low-value participation control rather than automatic Radar promotion.
